Flujo de Datos - Sistema de Reportes

sequenceDiagram actor U as Usuario participant App as OceanEyes App participant VM as ReportCreateVM participant DB as Firestore participant Box as AsyncStorage participant Sync as SyncEngine participant BC as PointLedger participant Push as FCM Note over U,Push: Online U->>App: Crea reporte (5 pasos) App->>VM: submit() VM->>DB: set({status:'submitted'}) DB-->>VM: OK Note over U,Push: Admin verifica actor A as Admin A->>DB: verifyReport(id) DB->>BC: awardPointsOnChain(wallet,N) BC-->>DB: txHash DB->>DB: status='verified', pointsAwarded=N DB->>Push: notificar Push-->>App: Reporte verificado +N pts Note over U,Push: Offline U->>App: Reporte sin internet App->>Box: guardar pendiente Box->>Sync: queue() Sync->>DB: publishReportOnline() DB-->>Sync: OK Sync-->>App: sincronizado

Stack Tecnologico

Frontend

  • TS Expo SDK 54 + RN 0.81
  • TS Expo Router (file-based)
  • TS ViewModel + useSyncExternalStore
  • TS react-native-maps + Leaflet
  • TS reanimated 4 + gesture-handler

Backend Firebase

  • JS Auth (email + Google + anon)
  • JS Firestore (9 collections)
  • JS Storage (media reportes)
  • JS FCM (push notifications)
  • JS Brevo (emails)

Blockchain

  • SOL PointLedger.sol (Ownable)
  • TS ethers.js v6.17
  • TS MetaMask (admin wallet)
  • SOL Arbitrum Sepolia L2
  • TS Hardhat (testing)

DevOps

  • JS Cloudflare Workers
  • JS Gradle 8.14 (Android)
  • JS Firebase Emulators
  • TS React Compiler
  • JS npm scripts deploy

APIs Externas

  • USGS Earthquakes (tsunami flag)
  • NOAA PTWC (alertas tsunami)
  • Open-Meteo Marine (olas/marea)
  • Brevo (email transaccional)
  • Cloudinary (CDN imagenes)

Colecciones Firestore

users

  • role, profileType, email, dni
  • walletAddress, pointsBalance
  • verifiedReportsCount, status

reports

  • userId, category, title, description
  • location, photoURLs, status
  • pointsAwarded, txHash

rewards

  • title, description, pointsCost
  • stock, active, sponsor, imageURL

redemptions

  • userId, rewardId, pointsSpent
  • status, shippingAddress
  • confirmedAt, shippedAt, deliveredAt

pointTransactions

  • userId, type, amount, reportId
  • txHash, balanceBefore, balanceAfter

bans + bannedDevices

  • reason, bannedBy, startsAt, endsAt
  • device hash (SHA-256)

alerts

  • title, message, severity
  • source (admin|usgs|noaa|user)
  • coordinates, radiusKm, active

alertReports

  • userId, type, location, photoURL
  • status (pending|verified|rejected)
  • clusteredWith, verifiedAt
